name: Parliament of Georgia (Sakartvelos Parlamenti)
notes: Unicameral, 150 seats. Seats by party list from the CEC count of the 26 October 2024 election as Interpressnews reported it on 27 Oct 2024 (3,100 of 3,111 precincts, 89 + 61 = 150). The opposition lists boycotted the chamber: three refused their mandates and Gakharia for Georgia kept them but stayed away, and later reports say Georgian Dream voted to revoke mandates, so the chamber does not sit as elected. parliament.ge was not read and no sitting member is listed, so no seat is lit.
